Scenario

You are a police officer receiving a report from a witness. The witness saw a suspicious beige van outside an electronics shop. Ask clear questions to obtain a useful description of the vehicle, its movements and the people involved. Give appropriate safety advice at the end.

Instructions

Reply in English as the officer. Respond using 1–2 sentences for each turn (1–6). Use at least five suggested phrases across your answers.

Study Timer10:00
